Meta.homeTitle: Escale Voyages · Premium journeys through the whole of Benin
Meta.homeDescription: The whole of Benin, at your pace. Small-group and private journeys from the Atlantic coast to the Pendjari savannah: royal cities, living Vodun, stilt towns, sacred hills, Tata Somba country and wildlife. Based in Cotonou.

Hero.statement: Luxury and discovery across the whole of Benin, from the Atlantic to the savannah.
Hero.tagline: The whole of Benin, at your pace
Hero.mediaSlot: hero-loop.mp4 · 16:9 · ≤8s · ≤2 MB · poster hero-poster.jpg 2400×1350. Mobile shows the poster only.

Intro.statement: One small country. Twelve kingdoms, two national parks, a coast with nobody on it.
Intro.body1: Benin runs 700 kilometres from the Atlantic to the Niger river, and almost nobody has seen all of it. The stilt town of Ganvié, the royal palaces of Abomey, the sacred hills of Dassa, the fortified Tata Somba houses of the Atakora, the lions of Pendjari, the Gèlèdé masks of Kétou. We take you to all of it, slowly, in comfort, with people who belong there.
Intro.body2: Small groups, never more than eight. Private guides from every region. Every journey is built around one story and told properly.

Season.title: October to March. Dry roads, clear skies, harmattan light.
Season.body: Journeys run through the dry season, when the lagoons are calm, the north is passable and the animals of Pendjari and the W gather at the waterholes. January brings Vodun Days to Ouidah. We travel year round on the coast and in the south.

Founder.quote: Everyone who comes to Benin sees Ouidah and Ganvié. Almost nobody sees Kétou, or the Collines, or the north. We started Escale Voyages so that people would see the whole country, and see it well.

Route.title: The length of the country
Route.body: The road north leaves the lagoon, climbs through the Collines and the Dahomey Gap, crosses the Bariba plains and ends at the Atakora range. We break it in Abomey, Dassa and Natitingou. There is no hurry; the road is the journey.
Route.mapSlot: Commissioned line-art map of Benin, SVG

Return.title: For those whose story passed through this gate.
Return.body: Ancestry-led itineraries from Ouidah's Route des Esclaves to the villages the records point to. Help with documents, DNA results, and the quiet logistics of coming back. Our signature journey, built with diaspora travellers.

Planning.title: Start planning your journey
Planning.body: Tell us when you can travel and what you are looking for. A real person replies within one working day, by email or WhatsApp.

1.title: Consultation
1.body: A call or WhatsApp conversation to understand what you want from Benin, your dates and your pace.

2.title: Confirmation
2.body: You confirm dates with a deposit, in FCFA by mobile money or in euros by card.

3.title: Planning
3.body: We build the day-by-day, book guides and rooms, and send a single itinerary document.

4.title: Documents
4.body: E-visa, health recommendations and insurance, with our checklist and reminders.

5.title: Arrival briefing
5.body: We meet you at Cotonou airport. A briefing on money, etiquette and Vodun protocol over your first meal.

6.title: Departure
6.body: Photos, a written account of your journey, and the door left open for the next one.

AboutPage.metaDescription: Escale Voyages is a Cotonou tour operator for the whole of Benin. Small groups, private guides from every region, and journeys built around one story each.
AboutPage.title: The whole country, told properly
AboutPage.intro: Escale Voyages is a tour operator based in Cotonou. We take small groups and private travellers across the whole of Benin, from the Atlantic to the Niger river, with guides who belong to the places they show you.
AboutPage.why1: Everyone who comes to Benin sees Ouidah and Ganvié. Almost nobody sees Kétou, the Collines, the Atakora or the W. The country runs 700 kilometres from the coast to the Niger and most itineraries stop at kilometre 150.
AboutPage.why2: We built Escale Voyages to show all of it, at a standard that matches the best operators anywhere: comfortable cars, good rooms, guides who know the history, a WhatsApp line that answers, and prices that are clear in FCFA before you commit.
AboutPage.howItems: Groups of eight at most · Private departures from two travellers · Guides from every region, French and English speaking · One itinerary document, no surprises · Vodun visited as guests, never as a show · 30% deposit, balance 45 days before
AboutPage.responsible1: Park fees fund rangers in Pendjari and the W. Ceremony contributions go to the temples that receive us. Guides, drivers and hosts are paid at Cotonou professional rates, and we book family-run lodges wherever they meet our standard.
AboutPage.responsible2: We do not visit orphanages, do not arrange photographs of people without their consent, and do not sell Vodun as a spectacle.
